
```{r pop_packages}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(patchwork)
library(showtext)
library(glue)
library(ggh4x)

showtext_auto()
font_add("Arial", regular = here("assets/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"))

options(scipen = 9999)
set.seed(708)
dir.create(here('figures'), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r pop_region_setup}
REGION_ORDER <- tibble(
  usfs_region = c(
    "California",
    "Southern",
    "Alaska",
    "Southern Rockies",
    "Southwestern",
    "Northern Rockies",
    "Intermountain",
    "Pacific Northwest",
    "Eastern",
    "Hawaii"
  ),
  plot_order = 10:1
)
# Keep in sync with the palette in _setup.qmd.
wfbz_ramp <- c(
  "#4A3A3B", "#6C3D38", "#8F4036", "#A64E4C", "#B8606A",
  "#CB7D82", "#DEA393", "#ECC5A8", "#EEDAC6", "#F0F0E4"
)
region_colors <- wfbz_ramp
attr(region_colors, "missing") <- NA
names(region_colors) <- sort(REGION_ORDER$usfs_region)

pop_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey25", fill = NA, linewidth = .25),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = .5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "pt"),
    legend.position = 'none'
  )
```
